ADX Energy Ltd.: Commencement of Austrian Well Work
Vienna Basin production enhancement and HOCH-1 Gas production testing program
MB Well Service Rig AW24 at Vienna Basin GA-93; ADX Energy Ltd.
"Production well work targeting a 100 BOEPD of incremental production from ADX' Vienna Basin Fields and Phase 2 testing of the HOCH-1 gas discovery"

) is pleased to advise the commencement of a work program utilising the MB Well Services workover rig. The program will focus on production enhancement activities across ADX' 100% owned Vienna Basin Fields, as well as the testing of the HOCH-1 gas discovery well within the ADX-AT-I exploration licence in Upper Austria. ADX is the operator and holds a 50% economic interest in the HOCH gas discovery. Figure 3 below shows the location of the Vienna Basin Fields and the ADX-AT-I and ADX-AT-II exploration licences.
The work program described below is expected to have a duration of approximately eight (8) weeks. ADX will provide work program results as they become available.
The program of well work activities and is scheduled as follows:
Vienna Basin well: new gas zone completion
Vienna Basin oil well: pump replacement
Vienna Basin well: new oil zone completion
*Approximately two weeks of well work required at HOCH-1 prior to testing
The well work program objectives are summarised as follows:
The perforation of a gas zone and the recompletion of the GA-093 production well to a gas well is expected to deliver

of incremental gas production. Undertaking the work at this time is expected to generate elevated incremental cash flow due to high gas prices and strong gas demand during winter months. The current gas price in Europe is EUR 86 per MWh which is equivalent to an oil price of US$ 170 per barrel.

of incremental oil and gas production.
